Hannah J: I'll run the live deploy demo. Plan: git clone -> terraform init/plan/apply -> smoke verify. Using a trimmed module at repos/partner-refkits/cloudpartnerz/terraform/mini-lab.
Hannah J: Demo HCL snippet we'll show:
```hcl
module \"cpz_minilab\" {
  source = \"github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits//cloudpartnerz/terraform/mini-lab\"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = \"g4dn.xlarge\"
  enable_kms = true
}
```
Sofia R: I'll also add a 1-slide data-flow + KMS note since partners always ask about key handling.
